```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(t.line_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name ILIKE '%Wellington%'
  AND t.txn_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
  AND t.txn_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'
  AND t.is_valid = TRUE
```
